status.note: Novita's blog feed (https://blogs.novita.ai/rss.xml) has no post announcing an acquisition of the company.

retention.value: Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver the output
retention.quote: Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law.
retention.note: The same answer says technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is retained for 6 months. The privacy policy (https://novita.ai/legal/privacy-policy) says "Technical Information: Retained for 2 years for security and analytics purposes".

zdr.quote: Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls.

zdr_how.value: Nothing to turn on; it is the policy in the terms of service, with exceptions for legal requirements, providing the service and technical support
zdr_how.quote: We have adopted a "Zero Data Retention" policy, which means that we will not, unless otherwise required by applicable law (or as necessary to provide the Services or technical support to you): (i) log your Content for human review; or (ii) retain your Content beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you.
zdr_how.note: The terms add that Novita may apply automated safety screening tools to content.

training.quote: By Default, Novita AI will not use your Content to train our own models or to improve the Services.
training.note: The trust centre FAQ lists a "Model provider" as a sub-processor that receives API inputs and outputs for integrated models; the pages read do not say what those providers do with them.

soc2.quote: We are proud to be SOC 2 Type II Audited, and GDPR compliant.
soc2.note: The report itself is gated; the trust centre FAQ says it is available under NDA for enterprise customers.

attestations.note: The trust centre says "We are proud to be SOC 2 Type II Audited, and GDPR compliant." and its FAQ lists CCPA compliance; these are Novita's own statements of compliance with a law, which this field does not count. SOC 2 is in its own field.

subprocessors.quote: AWS acts as a primary infrastructure provider for hosting applications and storing data with various security and compliance certifications.
subprocessors.note: The page is a list of 13 names with a description each and no introductory sentence; the quote is from the first entry. The trust centre FAQ also names an unnamed "Model provider" category for integrated models, which this list does not itemise.

regions.note: The trust centre FAQ says the infrastructure is hosted on AWS data centers without naming regions; the docs name regions only for the Sandbox product.
